item.title: Player Death Animations
item.creator: Logdotzip
item.description:
More than 100 new custom player-based animations, any time you perish. Free Captive Souls, craft Death Trophies, raid Haunted Outposts, and play with new palettes of blocks!

+ Compatible with custom Texture Packs
+ Cause of death-based animations
+ Outpost structure world generation
+ Add-On Achievements
+ 60+ Custom Blocks
+ Statistics tracking

faqEntries.heading: Does this Add-On work with other Add-Ons and Texture Packs?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Player Death Animations should work with most Marketplace Add-Ons. There may be slight differences in how animations play, however, these do not impact the Add-On in any meaningful way.

faqEntries.heading: How does the Add-On work?
faqEntries.content: If a player dies, a death animation related to how the player died will play in 3rd person perspective. After the animation ends, the player can choose to respawn.

faqEntries.heading: Does it work in Multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Friends can see each other’s special death animations when they die in-game.

faqEntries.heading: Does this Add-On work with other non-Add-On content?
faqEntries.content: On a case-by-case basis - so long as the other content has not changed the needed base Minecraft files (like the player), Player Death Animations is meant to work with any content on a world with version 1.26.30 or newer.

howToEntries.heading: Overview
howToEntries.content:
The Add-On adds 100+ unique animations for players who meet their unfortunate end. Animations played are based on cause of death.

If a specific animation becomes unenjoyable, it can be toggled off or on in the Deaths section of the guide book’s main menu. Other Add-On options can be adjusted from the guide book’s Settings section.

The guide book also offers info about additional features like statistics, overworld structures, new items, new blocks, new entities, crafting recipes, and stonecutter recipes.

howToEntries.heading: Unlocking Animations
howToEntries.content: Player Death Animations offers several animations to start, but you can unlock even more by locating Captive Souls in the Nether. Freeing a Captive Soul rewards XP and unlocks additional death animations.

howToEntries.heading: Haunted Outposts
howToEntries.content: Haunted Outposts are ancient ruins scattered across the Overworld, containing death loot and collectible custom blocks. These structures inhabit the ominous Gloomy Wraiths, cursed spirits that attack players when provoked.

howToEntries.heading: New Blocks
howToEntries.content: The Add-On includes tons of new blocks, including Deadwood, a cursed wood variant. You can grow Deadwood trees, and craft its planks into buttons, pressure plates, fences, gates, trapdoors and more. Stonecutter recipes offer several decorative Death Trophy and Rubble blocks, while placing wood in campfires rewards you with Burnt wood variants.

howToEntries.heading: Death Models
howToEntries.content: You don't need to perish to view your death animations! The craftable Death Model Stand can be placed and loaded with any unlocked animation or unlocked visual, then powered with redstone for full experience.

howToEntries.heading: Achievements
howToEntries.content: The Add-On features many custom Achievements that not only provide some visible bragging rights, but also offer in-game bonuses.
